cards.card_text: Then Jesus says, “Now judgment is upon this world; now the prince of this world will be cast out.”
cards.verse_text: In response, Jesus said, “This voice was not for My benefit, but yours. Now judgment is upon this world; now the prince of this world will be cast out.

cards.card_text: And He won't speak with them much longer, because the prince of this world is coming, and he has no claim on Jesus.
cards.verse_text: And now I have told you before it happens, so that when it does happen, you will believe. I will not speak with you much longer, for the prince of this world is coming, and he has no claim on Me.

cards.card_text: So the world may know He loves the Father So the disciples will stay beside Him So the prince of this world will flee
cards.verse_text: But I do exactly what the Father has commanded Me, so that the world may know that I love the Father. Get up! Let us go on from here.

cards.card_text: True or false: He says the reason for judgment is that the prince of this world has been condemned.
cards.verse_text: and in regard to judgment, because the prince of this world has been condemned.
